scope: CPU-only mathematical and normal-log feasibility checks for1D vertical and3D attitude kinematic consistency. No classifier, training, model edits, existing cache/stat/label changes, test/Real or server access.
selection: Reuse all12 pre-existing source-train normal timing anchors in artifacts/causal_input_parity_v1_20261031/fit_timing.json: SIL/HIL x6 modes. Do not choose10 by results, replace bad cases, or expand scope.
prefix_policy: First10 frames of every original150-frame window excluded from residual branch checks, never zero/future filled. Full-crop first10 rows also NaN with explicit prefix mask.
physical_inputs: Original source ULog baro_alt_meter, local_position.vz, attitude.q[wxyz], sensor_combined.gyro_rad. Source identity/crop/grid and existing provenance are checked against existing causal case receipts. No z-score inputs or inverse-normalization approximation.
operational_clock: A causal delivered-stream diagnostic, not exact synchronous sensor physics. At each stream time only already published records may be used. Native publication change points drive exact piecewise-constant integration over fixed[t-0.2,t]; no interpolation, bfill or past rewrite using late observations. Original observation clocks, age and endpoint skew are retained and reported. Gyro clock remains declared publication proxy. This cannot be promoted to observation-synchronous residual certification merely by dividing by0.02.
vertical: r_h=h_available(t)-h_available(t-T)+integral(vz_available(s),s=t-T..t), units m. Use native event intervals, not50Hz numeric differentiation. Wrong-sign subtract-integral result is descriptive diagnostic, not a score-selected variant.
attitude: Normalize finite nonzero quaternions with explicit rejection for norm<1e-8. PX4 Hamilton wxyz/bodyFRD-to-NED. Right propagate R_start product(exp(omega_body*actual_native_interval)); residual Log(R_prediction^T R_available(t)) in radians. Left-multiplication propagation is a diagnostic negative control, never selected from empirical scores. No expected magnitude acceptance threshold.
validity: Require previous frozen original input span eligibility plus required native-message ages/values through full horizon. Latest invalid is never replaced by older good. Mark intervals crossing available attitude quaternion reset or velocity vertical/reset counter changes invalid separately; record unavailable reset fields without guessing. Record baro device changes if present.
normalization: None fitted or applied. Descriptive means/std/quantiles are not approved residual normalization. If later used for training, fit separate statistics on fixed eligible source-train normal contributions only, after diagnostic acceptance.
checks: nonidentity initial orientation with multi-axis noncommuting motion
native irregular intervals and delayed availability
evidence: Preserve original cap64 indices, all crop-grid residual rows/masks, native timestamp diagnostics, per-case and per-domain/mode summaries. Excluded is not normal/fault. No claim that small normal residual proves coordinate convention or that anomalies must enlarge residual.
stop_boundary: Only synthetic correctness and12 normal cases. Report limitations/failures; do not tune horizon, age budgets, fit physical parameters or start classifier training automatically.
